raw_file_record_contract.record: already-formed cluster block: cluster id + bounding-box header + xadd/yadd + optional HH:MM:SS + K cell rows + declared count
raw_file_record_contract.field0_raw: UNDOCUMENTED; preserved only; no new semantics assigned

cluster_semantics.source_chain: Zenodo states MCU were determined using Tsiligiannis-2014/Bosser-2015 procedure
cluster_semantics.spatial_rule_evidence: historical method: detection window extends 3 bit cells in every direction; recursive expansion; later merge passes

raw_reproduction.K2_literal_Manhattan_not_required: Task-1/raw geometry has dM>3 cases while square-3 invariant holds

cluster_semantics.temporal_rule_evidence: Bosser historical method also required detections within 2 seconds; additional merge passes existed. Exact implementation producing Zenodo files is not published.
cluster_semantics.cluster_id: post-processing sequence label; resets can mark parser segments, not proven parent-particle ids.

timestamp.availability: present only in 0.9-5 and 186 MeV proton files
timestamp.confirmed_semantics: second-resolution value attached to already-formed registered cluster
timestamp.not_established: incident-particle arrival time; unique parent-event time; complete raw readout chronology
timestamp.cross_cluster_use: diagnostic only; same/adjacent timestamp does not imply common parent

unavailable_observations: pre-clustering bitflip log for all proton runs
